summary: Megagon Industries' serene-but-demanding mountain sports series, starting with downhill biking and continuing into multiplayer skiing in Snow Riders.

entries.title: Lonely Mountains: Downhill
entries.definitive_edition: Windows PC release with Eldfjall Island DLC where owned

emulation.notes: Run natively on Windows with DLC installed if owned.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Windows PC release at highest stable settings

primary.version: PC release with Eldfjall Island DLC where owned
primary.why: Lonely Mountains: Downhill released for Windows, PlayStation 4, and Xbox One in October 2019, then Nintendo Switch in May 2020. Windows is the highest-fidelity route and the best path for the base game plus the Eldfjall Island DLC.
primary.how_to_play: Play the Windows PC version at the highest stable settings with the Eldfjall Island DLC installed if owned; use PS4/Xbox One/Switch only as access alternatives.

entries.remaster_caveats: No sourced remaster; install Eldfjall Island DLC if preserving all official course content.

entries.title: Lonely Mountains: Snow Riders

emulation.notes: Run natively on Windows at the highest stable settings.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Windows PC release at highest stable settings

primary.why: Lonely Mountains: Snow Riders released in January 2025 on Steam and Xbox Series X/S, adding cooperative gameplay and online multiplayer to the series' mountain-sports format. Windows is the highest-fidelity configurable route.
primary.how_to_play: Play the Windows PC version at the highest stable settings; use Xbox Series X/S as a console alternative for Game Pass or living-room play.

entries.remaster_caveats: Recent sequel; recheck post-launch updates or DLC if preserving a later complete build.
